svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A half cone 174 mm long, 2 mm wall, inside radius 41 mm at the elbow end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 35 mm at the wrist end (forearm plus the 4 mm liner); its edges

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stop 8 mm below the forearm's centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print on its back on tree supports; 12 mm holes on a grid every 17 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six 3.4 mm holes for the pack screws, 9 mm each side of the top line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at 18.5, 86.5 and 154.5 mm from the elbow end, on the solid strips

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: pack ribs sit on its top; M3 button-head screws go up from inside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: into the ribs' inserts; liner glued inside; straps go round outside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: sits on the forearm without rocking; the six screw holes line up
